goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.rules: Nimble Escape: can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action. Scimitar: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 slashing. Shortbow: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing, range 80/320.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.rules: Pack Tactics: advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5ft of the target. Bite: +4 to hit, 2d4+2 piercing; target must succeed on a DC 11 Strength save or be knocked prone.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.rules: Vulnerable to bludgeoning damage, immune to poison damage/condition. Shortsword: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing. Shortbow: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing, range 80/320.

banditThug.name: Bandit
banditThug.rules: Scimitar: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 slashing. Light Crossbow: +3 to hit, 1d8+1 piercing, range 80/320.

direWolf.name: Dire Wolf
direWolf.rules: Pack Tactics: advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5ft of the target. Bite: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 piercing; target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be knocked prone.
